dno_dashboard.subtitle: 3 regional DSOs · ~190,000 LV customers · 8 landshluti · 62 sveitarfélög (LAU)
dno_dashboard.intro: Iceland's distribution sector is split three ways geographically + by density tier. Veitur ohf. (Greater Reykjavík + 6 Faxaflói municipalities, ~55-60% of customers, OR-owned via Reykjavík + 2 other municipalities) is the highest-density DSO covering the Capital metropolitan area. RARIK ohf. (rural Iceland outside Greater Reykjavík and Suðurnes, ~30-35% of customers, 100% state-owned) covers ~85% of the country by area. HS Veitur hf. (Suðurnes/Reykjanes peninsula including Grindavík + Keflavík airport corridor + Vestmannaeyjar, ~10-15% of customers, HS Orka majority + state minority) covers the volcanically active Reykjanes peninsula — operationally critical to the 2023-2025 Sundhnúkur eruption response. The 8 Feb 2024 Sundhnúkur eruption damaged the regional hot-water pipeline (district heating from Svartsengi geothermal plant); ~26,000 residents in HS Veitur's territory lost heating for ~4 days. Grindavík remains evacuated as of 2026-05-29.
